name: Copy SKU for WooCommerce
author: karamel7

sections.description:
WooCommerce store managers frequently need to copy SKUs for inventory management, spreadsheets, or supplier communication.

This lightweight plugin adds a simple copy button next to each SKU in the WooCommerce product list.

Features:

• Copy SKU with one click
• Visual confirmation when copied
• Lightweight and zero configuration

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Products → All Products

You will see a copy button next to each SKU.
